{{Otheruses|Fisher}}
A '''fisher''', also called a '''fisherman''', was one who caught [[Fish/Legends|fish]] as a way of life.

==History==
The fishermen of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]] were able to export many tons of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] every [[Standard year/Legends|year]] to the Rebellion's cause.
